state: Built, DirectHiddenProbe and unit suites passed, live-loaded into Explorer, packaged at leandock-0.8.121-package

userRequest.Question: 有一个严重的问题。鼠标在悬浮面板上移动的时候会有实时光效，但是附近的文字也会根本像素级发抖有点难受
userRequest.Scope: Eliminate subpixel/pixel-level text jitter near the pointer-following specular light on the hover panel at fractional DPI scales (150% / 144 DPI) while preserving the real-time sheen/glint light effect, liquid glass, and entrance/exit/height animations.

change.DirectMotionScaleAndOpacity: Replaced permanent ExpressionAnimations on motion.Scale (p.Zoom) and motion.Opacity (p.Alpha) with direct keyframe animations (MotionScale / MotionOpacity) so once entrance settles at 1.0, DWM exits the EffectVisual group-opacity offscreen intermediate surface path whose 1.5x DIP dirty-rect alignment alternated between .0 and .5 physical pixels around sheen/glint.
change.DecoupledPointerLightAndPixelSnapping: Removed p.Light from shared props (setting sheen.EllipseCenter and glint.EllipseCenter directly after physical-pixel SnapDip deduplication so pointer movement never invalidates panel geometry expressions), enabled ICompositionSurfaceBrush3::SnapToPixels(true) on contentBrush and pageBrush, snapped band sizes and InsetClip cuts (55 DIP -> 83 px, 157 DIP -> 236 px) to integer physical pixels, and changed Drawing::Redraw surface sizing from std::ceil to std::lround for exact 1:1 texel-to-pixel alignment.

notVerified: Interactive desktop pointer movement across hover panel text at 150% DPI pending user visual confirmation
